Contoso Industrial Corp

Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers.

On October 1, 2026, Robert Vance notified Contoso Industrial Corp (the "Company") that he resigned as Chief Technology Officer of the Company, effective October 31, 2026. Mr. Vance's decision was not the result of any disagreement with the Company.

The Board has begun a search for his successor.
